thread:
Clara (PM): quick sync — proposing an automated design-partner onboarding + retention workflow to cut manual ops. prototype goals: (1) reduce recruit->first-successful-run time from days to hours, (2) capture structured feedback + NPS at 3 touchpoints, (3) trigger retention nudges (credits/email) when engagement drops. looking for engineering + research + design volunteers to spike this week.
Diego (Eng-Platform): 👍 can you sketch the automation surface? webhooks, tasks, who owns state? any security/consent constraints? 
Clara (PM): rough idea — webhook from signup -> onboarding-runner service creates tenant, seeds prompt bank, provisions trial credits, schedules check-ins. consent recorded in tenant metadata. simple YAML rule engine for triggers. e.g.
```
triggers:
  - event: first_model_call
    action: seed_prompt_bank
  - event: 72h_no_calls
    action: send_retention_email
```
Diego (Eng-Platform): nice. prefer Queue+Worker vs cron for 72h_no_calls. queue lets us backfill and reprocess. also need idempotency keys for replays.
Rhea (Research): add: embedded eval prompt bank + sampling policy so we get representative quality signals onboard. capture contextual metadata (model, seq len, concurrency) with every eval.
Jon (Solutions Eng): we also need to define incentives: what credit amount gets a user to come back? and consent language for shipping feedback to research. legal may want explicit opt-in for sharing logs.
Ava (Design): I'll draft email + in-app microcopy. suggestion: 2 variants — soft nudge (tips + quick-start) and strong incentive (100 credits). want copy points, can we A/B easily? 🤔
Clara (PM): yes A/B'ing incentive amounts and copy should be part of spike. we should also rollback easily if a variant underperforms.
Marcus (Eng-SRE): metric list to track: time_to_first_successful_call, percent_seed_success, 3-day active rate, churn_by_cohort, cost_per_retention_credit. also SLO considerations for onboarding-runner (p95 < 3s for tenant creation API).
onboard-bot: scheduled reminder set for spike kickoff: 2026-03-31 10:00 UTC
Diego (Eng-Platform): volunteer to own infra spike. estimate 2-3 days to a working PoC (queue + worker + idempotency + basic dashboard).
Rhea (Research): I can own prompt bank + eval hooks. will prepare 40 seed prompts across 3 verticals.
Jon (Solutions Eng): I'll own incentives + legal checklist with Caroline.
Ava (Design): I'll mock email + in-app flows by EOD Fri.
Clara (PM): perfect. outcome for spike: deploy PoC, sample of 50 design-partner seats, wired metrics dashboard, draft retention experiments. decision point next Wed: proceed to pilot or iterate on spike. any blockers? ✋
Marcus (Eng-SRE): need approval for ephemeral trial GPUs for testing; will open infra request ticket.
Clara (PM): noted — I'll add to the calendar and create a short PRD with acceptance criteria (deployable PoC, data captured in analytics, consent flow validated). thanks all. 🚀
